systems.owner: Directorate of e-Health, with the Data.FI Project and OpenFn developers

systems.system: three digital health platforms connected to DHIS2 (unnamed)

note: The document is about an exchange-class system: the first national interoperability layer (OpenFn) automating data exchange between three unnamed health platforms and the national DHIS2, announced 2026-08-13; it also says Niger had more than 32 largely isolated digital health platforms in 2023. The national DHIS2 is named without a description of what it reports, so it is unclassified and gives no hmis fact.
